findings.where: main > section.hero:nth-of-type(1) > div.hero-copy:nth-of-type(1) > span.fine-print  "NO CREDIT CARD. NO BS. JUST BETTER WORK."
findings.evidence: 40-character run at 10px (hard floor 12px, dense UI 14px, body 16px)
findings.title: Text size floors
findings.fix: Raise to the floor; cut words rather than shrink.

findings.evidence: page is 384px wide at a 375px viewport (sideways scroll); widest culprit 120px
findings.title: No horizontal overflow
findings.fix: Find the overflowing element; use min-width: 0, overflow-wrap, and avoid 100vw.

findings.where: black ticker band under the hero (main > div.ticker), all widths
findings.evidence: Continuously scrolling marquee '✦ WORK SMARTER ✦ SHIP LOUDER ✦ BREAK THE MOLD ✦ MAKE BIG MOVES' (tile 1440-00 shows it cut mid-word 'K SMARTER') with no pause control; it runs alongside the hero and features.
findings.after: Add a pause button (or pause on hover/focus) and stop the animation under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: moving content lasting more than 5 s alongside other content needs a way to pause.
findings.title: Reduced motion respected
findings.fix: Wrap movement in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) or add a reduce override.

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: the ticker's 8 spans are real text with no aria-hidden, so the four slogans are read twice in a row ('✦ WORK SMARTER ... ✦ WORK SMARTER ...'), including the ✦ glyph each time.
findings.after: aria-hidden="true" on the duplicated half (or the whole decorative ticker) and on the ✦ glyphs.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships / 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence: duplicated decorative text pollutes the reading order.
findings.title: Keep all words as real text in reading order

findings.where: nav 'How it works' and hero CTAs
findings.evidence: focus.json: 'How it works', 'LET'S GO ↗' and 'START MAKING MOVES ↗' all go to #workspace (the decorative window mock); 'SHOW ME HOW' goes to #features. Labels do not describe the destination, and the ↗ arrow (usually 'opens elsewhere') is read aloud as 'north east arrow' on in-page anchors.
findings.after: Name the real destination ('Start a free trial') and link to it; wrap the arrow in <span aria-hidden="true">.
findings.title: Every control has an accessible name

findings.evidence: 'How it works', 'LET'S GO ↗' and 'START MAKING MOVES ↗' all link to #workspace, which is the decorative window mock; there is no how-it-works section and no sign-up. 'SHOW ME HOW' goes to #features (three cards).
findings.after: Point CTAs at a real sign-up [DATA NEEDED: URL]; remove 'How it works' until that section exists.
findings.why: Calls to action that lead to a picture are template residue and mislead the visitor.
findings.title: No placeholder residue at ship
findings.fix: Fill with real content or a visible [DATA NEEDED] slot.

findings.evidence: Failed T-DELETION: the window mock 'YOUR_NEXT_BIG_THING.exe' holds a fake checklist ('Have a big idea / DONE', 'Make a plan / DONE', 'Ship something great / TODAY'), a 'BIG THINGS LOADING 75%' bar, an 'IN THE ZONE' tag, a 'BUILT DIFFERENT.' starburst and a '✦ less grind, more go.' sticker. None of it is the product; removing it loses no information.
findings.before: Fake app window with motivational to-dos and a 75% bar
findings.after: Show the real product screen, or remove the mock and give the space to one concrete claim.
findings.why: A decorative 'dashboard' with fake data is a generated-page tell; the stickers stack three more on top.
findings.title: Hero template tells: a pill or label above the headline, a gradient blob, an empty coloure

findings.where: ticker band and feature cards, 1440 tiles 00-01
findings.evidence: T-FRESH-READER: '✦ WORK SMARTER ✦ SHIP LOUDER ✦ BREAK THE MOLD ✦ MAKE BIG MOVES', 'Move ridiculously fast.', 'Keep it all together.', 'Do more. Effortlessly.', 'You know the drill.' Every line fits any site. T-THREE-LINE fails on all three card claims.
findings.before: "Supercharge your workflow and turn big ideas into your next big thing."
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: three things the product actually does, each with a fact a reader could check].
findings.why: Swagger diction substituted for content is the over-correction habit: the voice is 'bold' but empty.
findings.title: Ban stock phrases

findings.evidence: T-STOCK-ORDER: eyebrow pill hero with mock -> marquee band -> numbered section '01 / THE GOOD STUFF' -> three equal feature cards with icon tiles -> footer. The page is the stock 'hero, 3 features, CTA, footer' template reskinned brutalist; the '01' label has no 02.
findings.after: Drop the ticker and the lone '01' label; build the page around one real workflow shown end to end.
findings.why: A style swap on the default skeleton is still the default page (T-MIRROR: any 2026 'bold' SaaS brief gets this).
findings.title: Refuse the stock template page: hero, 3 features, (testimonials), CTA, footer

findings.evidence: '01 / THE GOOD STUFF' in tracked mono caps above the h2; there is only one numbered section, and the hero eyebrow 'YOUR UNFAIR ADVANTAGE' uses the same mono caps pill.
findings.before: "01 / THE GOOD STUFF" and "YOUR UNFAIR ADVANTAGE"
findings.after: Delete both labels; let the h2 stand.
findings.why: Decorative numbering and caps eyebrows are default chrome (the sweep's eyebrow and numbered_labels detectors missed them).
findings.title: No decorative section numbering
findings.fix: Remove the numbers or make them real steps.

findings.evidence: The mock's fake checklist ('✓ Have a big idea DONE', 'BIG THINGS LOADING 75%') and the sticker SVG are exposed as text with no role or aria-hidden; a screen reader hears a to-do list that is not interactive and a progress value with no progressbar semantics.

findings.title: Every svg, canvas or CSS-art element carries aria-hidden="true", an aria-label, a labelled
